name: MoGUI
notes: The card carries the license, links and citation requests (MobA, META-GUI, CAM-GUI and a MoGUI/MoCon technical report); the announced complete report remains unlinked, leaving the paper relation unrecorded. The repository's MoGUI_Paper_v0.1.pdf is a two-page pre-release announcement without methods or statistics. Android is established by the metadata: Google Play package names, android.widget element classes and Android permission-controller screens. At revision 19639219 the manifest holds 200 metadata JSON shards, 200 moguidata tar.gz shards totalling about 1.14 TB, and an apk_infos.json file of Google Play listing fields per package. Metadata shard 1 alone holds navigation graphs for 1,084 app packages listing 13,726 valid screens. A streamed read of the start of the first tar.gz shard showed per-app folders of PNG screenshots with same-named XML files. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 is the card's data declaration and does not establish rights to the third-party apps shown. The sibling MoCon dataset is a separate release.
summary: Android app GUI crawl with per-app navigation graphs that link screen IDs through the UI action taken, plus 200 archive shards of the captured screens.
